policy: A feature is production-ready only when CI proof, automated tests, staging proof, observability, real user-flow proof, and rollback/recovery proof are all present. Exposed production features without proof must fail verification.

features.name: Frontend Boot
features.notes: Basic app shell is smoke-tested. Real SaaS UI flows still require Playwright/staging proof.

features.name: Health, Readiness, Metrics, Version
features.notes: Route contracts exist. Live Render and staging proof still required.

features.name: Production Gates
features.notes: Build-time guardrails exist and now verify GitHub Actions workflows opt into the Node 24 JavaScript actions runtime and avoid deprecated Node 20 action major pins before GitHub's June 2, 2026 enforcement date. Keep expanding gate checks as features are certified.

features.name: Authentication and Login
features.notes: Must not be called production-ready until session/JWT/reset/rate-limit/protected-route tests exist.

features.name: RBAC and Permissions
features.notes: Explicit SaaS permission matrix, permission guard tests, modular vehicle inventory-write route contracts, full inventory view read guard, and legacy conversation message read/write route contracts exist. Full route migration, sensitive action audit proof, staging proof, and user-flow proof remain critical blockers.

features.name: Tenant Isolation
features.notes: Tenant context boundary has automated tests for header spoofing, legacy tokens, explicit super-admin selection, owner guard behavior, vehicle route tenant-context fail-closed behavior, and legacy conversation route dealership context. Full route/storage cross-tenant isolation across all resources remains a critical blocker.

features.name: Inventory CRUD
features.notes: Needs route, tenant, UI, duplicate VIN, and source-truth tests.

features.name: VIN Validation Foundation
features.notes: VIN format and check-digit validation are covered by automated tests. Provider decode, batch decode, cache/rate limiting, and provider reconciliation still require proof.

features.name: Olympic Hyundai Scraper
features.notes: Extraction tests prove missing year/make/model source facts are not fabricated. Live pagination, source-truth reconciliation, quarantine, observability, and staging proof remain required.

features.name: Robust Scraper
features.notes: Compiles and fails closed. Not certified as a working scraper.

features.name: Facebook Marketplace Posting
features.notes: Modular and legacy Facebook Pages routes require explicit integrations read/write RBAC and tenant-scoped updates. Facebook account, template, queue, manual post, and config routes require dealership context before storage. Marketplace posting must remain draft/human-approved until token, duplicate, image, posting, and failure tests exist.

features.name: AI Lead Response
features.notes: Needs inventory-grounding, finance guardrail, prompt injection, escalation, and human approval tests.

features.name: GHL CRM Sync
features.notes: Needs OAuth, token refresh, webhook verification, sync log, and duplicate-contact tests.

features.name: Billing and Plans
features.notes: Required for self-serve SaaS but not required for controlled pilot.
